# Task Management Requirements Quality Checklist

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality checklist for Task Management.
**Created**: 2026-11-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned. Mark `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the criterion is satisfied.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are task CRUD requirements fully specified (create, edit, delete)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are completion toggle requirements defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are priority/due date/duration requirements specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Are persistence and restore requirements defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 Are empty/invalid input states addressed? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "meaningful title" quantified (min length)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is priority default specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Is estimated duration unit (minutes) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do completion and deletion rules align (no auto-delete)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Are accessibility requirements consistent with Constitution §XIII? [Consistency, Spec §Accessibility]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Are success criteria measurable and verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are guest storage loss scenarios addressed? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are keyboard accessibility requirements defined? [Coverage, Spec §Accessibility]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK014 Are i18n (en/es) requirements specified? [NFR, Spec §Accessibility]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK015 Are assumptions (no backend/auth) documented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK016 Is "organizing tasks" defined (sort order)? [Ambiguity, Spec §Scope]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
